source: WHO Weekly Epidemiological Record 1980;55(21) - Corrigendum to Cholera in 1979 (23 May 1980)
processing_notes: Source states: 'Insert: ... p. 129, second paragraph, second line: 845 ... p. 130, Table 1, Africa, Sudan: 845' - interpreted as 143 sCh cases. Derived remainder: WHO's corrected 1979 total for Sudan (845 cases; corrigendum to 'Cholera in 1979', WER 1980;55(18), metadata 123) minus the revised IHR notifications of 18 Jun-10 Jul (638, AI row from metadata 121) and 12-20 Jul (64, metadata 120) = 143 cases notified for the remainder of 1979. TR 1979-12-31 is the annual boundary; the Equatoria towns were still on WHO's infected-area list on 6 Dec 1979 (metadata 122). Deaths not derivable from WHO WER (WHO GHO gives 176 deaths for Sudan 1979, i.e. ~65 after the notified 111, but that would imply an implausible ~45% CFR, so left blank). All 1979 Sudanese cholera areas were in Equatoria Province -> AFR::SSD. Confidence 0.6 (derived, period boundaries uncertain). National total - includes provinces not individually listed.
retracted_reason: Agent 1 self-correction: derived remainder (845 - 638 - 64 = 143 for 21 Jul-31 Dec 1979) superseded by the actual WHO IHR notification 11 Aug-2 Oct 1979: 207 cases/78 deaths (WER 1979;54(40), AI 131); WHO's annual 845/176 = 638+207 / 98+78
